rows.note: Use 縣 as the all-purpose equivalent, especially for an administratively governed county such as one in China or the United States.

example.english: This county is an administrative area in the United States.
example.traditional: 呢個縣係美國嘅一個行政區。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jyun6 hai6 mei5 gwok3 ge3 jat1 go3 hang4 zing3 keoi1

rows.note: Use 郡 for UK-style or historically named counties, especially when the county is being treated as a geographic rather than current administrative unit.

example.english: Yorkshire is a well-known county in northern England.
example.traditional: 約克郡係英格蘭北部一個好出名嘅地區。
example.jyutping: joek3 hak1 gwan6 hai6 jing1 gaak3 laan4 bak1 bou6 jat1 go3 hou2 ceot1 meng2 ge3 dei6 keoi1
